title: Fed minutes on September hike in focus

timeline.title: Fed minutes on September hike in focus
timeline.line: September meeting lifted US rates to 3.75–4.00%, the first Fed hike since 2023
more: Projections pointed to one more hike in 2026
Soft jobs and inflation data since then cut October hike odds to about 20%
Minutes were due for release on Oct 7 at 2 pm ET
